title: Graph Radical Quotient
body_html:
Graph Radical Quotient

Let \(b=B_{0:0+}\) be the finite symplectic quotient of the oscillator lattice, and let \[ \overline\iota:\mathbf g_{x,s:s+}\oplus\mathbf g'_{x',s:s+}\to b \] be the map induced by \((X,X')\mapsto -wX+X'w\). Let \(N(X)=(X,d\alpha(X))\) be the graph map. Then:

  • \(d\alpha:r\to r'\) is an isomorphism of radicals.
  • The sequence \(0\to r\to\mathbf g_{x,s:s+}\oplus\mathbf g'_{x',s:s+}\to b\) along \(N\) and \(\overline\iota\) is exact.
  • The image \(b_C=\overline\iota(r)=\overline\iota(r')\) is isotropic and \(b_C^\perp=\operatorname{Im}(\overline\iota)\).
  • In Case I, the quotient \(b_0=b_C^\perp/b_C\) is a nondegenerate finite symplectic space identified with the two noncentral final layers. In Case II, \(b_C=b_C^\perp\) and \(b_0=0\).
proof_html: The radical isomorphism follows from the graded isomorphism \(d\alpha\) of Lemma 6.2 and the radical computation of Lemma 6.4. Exactness is proved by writing \[ \overline\iota(X,d\alpha(X))=-wX+d\alpha(X)w, \] and replacing \(wXw^{-1}\) by \(d\alpha(X)+d\alpha^\perp(X)\); the \(d\alpha^\perp\) term is deeper for \(X\in r\). Conversely, if \(\overline\iota(X,X')=0\), the isometry of Lemma 6.3 puts \((X,X')\) in \(r\oplus r'\), and then injectivity on the target quotient forces \(X'=d\alpha(X)\). The statements about \(b_C^\perp\) and \(b_0\) follow by dimension counting and the two cases of Lemma 6.4.
